summary: I'm Still Here is a social-first educational advocacy campaign told from the perspective of the moon, giving renewed visibility to human made artifacts that remain on the lunar surface.
details:
Premise and Backstory

I’m Still Here is a social-first advocacy campaign told from the Moon’s unique perspective. For over 50 years, humanity came, made history, and left—leaving behind a trail of quiet machinery, rovers, and experiments that eventually went silent. Inspired by witnessing the Orion capsule and the Artemis II mission fly past its horizon, the Moon realized humanity was finally returning and felt compelled to step up as an advocate for its forgotten artifacts. By giving these abandoned relics a voice, I’m Still Here bridges our historic past with our next giant leap, ensuring the objects that remained on the lunar surface aren't left behind in the history books.

WHAT “I’M STILL HERE” DOES

I’m Still Here blurs the line between fiction and reality through immersive world-building, utilizing social media as its primary medium to place the audience directly on the receiving end of the experience. By bringing the Moon to life as a personified advocate for abandoned lunar artifacts, the campaign is designed to make viewers feel as though this social feed is happening out in the real world.

Mechanism

social media style posts of real lunar artifacts

Purpose

The campaign operates on three ideas: curiosity first, education second, and lunar heritage preservation third.

Core Narrative

You left. I stayed. So did your history. Now you're coming back. Let's make sure you remember what's still here.

HOW IT WORKS

Users navigate the screens as though they are using the Instagram platform. From there, clicking through selected posts enhances the immersion, giving it a realistic social media app experience.

Navigation & Experience

Users begin their journey directly from the campaign’s profile page. From here, they can explore select posts, drop reactions, and read through comments.

To deepen the storytelling, certain posts feature embedded multi-image galleries, allowing visitors to swipe through and uncover additional archival layers within a single post.

Designer's Tip: Click on any white space in the interactive prototype to see live elements.

Tools/Misc.

Figma - interactive prototype

Canva - project presentation/demo

Gemini - writing, grammar, hackathon timekeeping/pacing, scheduling, troubleshooting
